pages.title: Cold Hearthblade
pages.text: Set it on a lit campfire to rekindle it. A soul campfire wakes its blue flame.

pages.title: Hearthblade
pages.text: Kills cook their drops and store an ember (half a food point, up to 10). Sneak + use to eat the embers.

pages.title: Soul Hearthblade
pages.text: Kills cook their drops in soul fire (one extra) and store an ember. Sneak + use to eat the embers.
